posts.t: Patrick Kane over the last three seasons has been a mediocre 2nd line forward who gets 1st line opportunities. He does not need to be the topic du jour of 60% of this broadcast, TSN.
If the broadcast could stop glazing Patrick Kane, who hasn't been a star player since 2022, it would be nice.
That was Patrick Kane's first 5v5 primary assist this season.

Patrick Kane admits he hasn't had a "dream start" to the season. He hasn't scored since the season opener, for one thing.

But he also sees reasons for optimism, both for himself and the Blackhawks.
